actions.name: Overload Sensors
actions.description: As a standard action, make a ranged attack against another mech within 120 feet. If it hits, the targeted mech gains the blinded and deafened conditions for 1 round and loses any blindsense; the targeted mech must succeed at a Fortitude save to negate (DC = 12 + 1/2 mech's tier).

description.value:
Wide-range energy waves overwhelm enemy sensors.

@PPAbility[cost:4]{Overload Sensors} Impose the blinded and deafened conditions on an enemy mech for 1 round.

Save DC: 12 + half mech tier.
